records.subject: spec-guard-codex-cli-smoke
evidence: result:the first run exited 2 because the Codex login had expired (refresh_token_invalidated); after the user signed in again the smoke exited 0 and its machine session record contained a valid Spec Guard phase injection

records.subject: spec-guard-codex-context-thresholds
records.reason: the Codex window path (model_context_window from the rollout, 50% / 80%) is covered by regression tests only; no real Codex session reached 129k at a module boundary or 207k mid-module during this release, and whether Codex passes transcript_path to the hook is still unobserved.
